node.title: Re^2: shift split grep question
node.author: Eily
node.doctext:
Rather than splice you can use [doc://undef] to ignore unwanted elements. Like this: my (undef, @headings) = split ' ', first {/^\s*AUID/} @lines;

Going further (it's not related to the OP anymore) it works exactly as if there was one scalar in that place that was then ignored. So in the following example: (undef, $second, undef, $hash{fourth}, @rest, undef) = some_function() The first and third values are ignored, the second and fourth get in $second and $hash{fourth}, but @rest gets all the following values, and the last [doc://undef] is useless. So it let's you ignore values counting from the left, but never couting from the right.
